note: Combat voice casting. family = clip prefix in boss-voice-manifest.json (<family>-attack1..3, hurt1..3, cast, release, death). The four original bosses (earth/fire/ice/lightning) use named families so the elemental fallback boss-<element>-* stays unchanged. Elite variants: a = lighter/agile, b = heavy/deep.

earth.note: Thạch Mộc Cự Vệ: moss-and-stone tree golem, no human face. Real grizzly-bear roars pitched down with creaking wood and grinding stone.

fire.note: Hỏa Long Tro Tàn: red winged dragon. Real lion roars (slowed) over an alligator growl, ember breath.

ice.note: Băng Nguyệt Linh Hồ: the art is a white feathered fox/owl-like beast, not a human queen. Real red-fox screams, slowed, with a frosty snake-hiss breath.

lightning.note: Lôi Sư Thiên Đỉnh: purple maned feline beast. Real tiger snarls and roar with a lion layer and electric crackle.

mire.note: Mẫu Nấm Độc: robed mushroom matron with a staff and hands, humanoid, named "mother". Old-witch voice actor (CC0), lowered, with a demonic double.

scarab.note: Bọ Vương Hoàng Kim: giant golden beetle. Real Madagascar hissing-cockroach hisses, slowed, with cicada chitter and a low body.

leviathan.note: Hải Long San Hô: teal coral sea serpent. Real crocodile screams (slowed) and alligator growls over a low humpback-whale bed.

colossus.note: Cự Tượng Bánh Răng: brass gear golem, a machine. Distorted real elephant trumpet slowed into a mechanical bellow, steam hiss, stressed metal.

prism.note: Bọ Ngựa Lăng Tinh: crowned crystal mantis/wasp queen with an insect head (compound eyes, mandibles), not a human face. Real wasp buzz and cicada with scraping glass.

reaper.note: Tử Thần Nguyệt Ảnh: hooded reaper with no visible face, gender not shown. Performed shrieking wraith voice (CC0), ghost breath and moan.

roc.note: Đại Bàng Thiên Phong: giant eagle. Real red-tailed hawk screeches, slowed for size.

briar.note: Nữ Hoàng Gai: thorn queen, clearly a woman (face, rose crown, gown). Female fighting-grunt actor (CC0) with a light weight double; death from a separate female agony recording.

seraph.note: Thiên Sứ Nhật Quang: broad armored winged knight, male build. Male fight grunts for attacks, a male pain-grunt actor for hurt/cast/release/death, lowered with a light double.

eclipse.note: Long Đế Hư Không: starry void dragon. CC0 composite roars built from real lion, elephant, crocodile and alligator recordings, slowed and darkened.

elderbloom.note: Thụ Vương Bạch Hoa: antlered treant. Real moose/elk bellows with tree-trunk creaks.

cinderheart.note: Bạo Chúa Tâm Nham: lava rock golem. Real gorilla roar and black-bear growl, slowed, on a lion growl rumble with grinding stone and embers.

frostregent.note: Nữ Đế Băng Tinh: ice empress, clearly a woman. Female battle-cry actor (CC0), slightly lowered, cold presence, octave shadow.

tempestwing.note: Sư Ưng Lôi Hoàng: armored storm eagle. Real eagle squawks and calls with electric crackle; a different species and recordist from the roc.

souljailer.note: Cai Ngục Vong Đăng: hooded lantern wraith, gender not shown. Low performed ghost/demon groans (CC0) with a moaning-wraith layer.

sporefather.note: Lão Vương Bào Tử: mushroom-covered giant with no human face. Real camel groans (gurgling) slowed, with creaking wood. Borderline: humanoid silhouette and "father" in the name.

prismback.note: Huyền Quy Tinh Thành: giant tortoise carrying a crystal citadel. Real elephant trumpet and rumble slowed, with stone and glass grind.

sandchronarch.note: Sa Vương Thời Luân: robed, masked sand king with a humanoid body, a male ruler. Aggressive male growl actor (CC0), lowered, demonic double and sand grit; death from a male scream recording.

coraltide.note: Long Vương Châu Triều: coral sea dragon. Real sea-lion roars (slowed) over a humpback-whale bed; mammalian, unlike the reptilian leviathan.

moonfang.note: Lang Vương Tử Nguyệt: wolf-headed armored werewolf. Real wolf growls, dog snarls and a solitary wolf howl for cast/death. Borderline: humanoid body, but the head is fully a wolf.
